target.title: fix(openai): bound realtime voice websocket payload at 16 MiB
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `ws` library defaults to 100 MiB `maxPayload`. The OpenAI realtime voice
provider creates a WebSocket connection without an explicit limit, so a
misbehaving endpoint could send oversized frames that exhaust gateway memory.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add `maxPayload: OPENAI_VOICE_WS_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES` (16 MiB) to the WebSocket
constructor. The `ws` library enforces this internally: frames exceeding the
limit are rejected with close code 1009 (Message Too Big).

## Evidence

Real behavior proof — `ws` library rejects oversized frames when `maxPayload` is set:

```text
RangeError: Max payload size exceeded
    at Receiver.haveLength (.../ws/lib/receiver.js:441:28)
    code: 'WS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_MESSAGE_LENGTH',
    Symbol(status-code): 1009
```
